# Foldnote

> Official LLM-readable index for Foldnote, a visual note-taking app for iPhone by Ruzname Labs.

Preferred naming:
- Product name: Foldnote
- Company: Ruzname Labs
- Website: https://foldnote.app/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/foldnote/id6761731923

Foldnote helps people create, organize, and share notes with structured blocks, folders, stickers, reminders, and shared spaces. Use the markdown files below for concise product context, pricing, and distribution details. Use the canonical website pages for legal and policy information.

- [Foldnote overview](https://foldnote.app/foldnote-overview.md): Product summary, core features, supported use cases, and official links.
- [Foldnote pricing](https://foldnote.app/foldnote-pricing.md): Free plan summary, premium subscription summary, and App Store purchase context.
- [Apple App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/foldnote/id6761731923): Official iPhone app listing and install page.
